eventMetadata.context_description: The New York Yankees hold a substantial edge in the American League wild-card race at 67-52 while hosting the struggling Seattle Mariners (56-64) at Yankee Stadium. New York has capitalized on its home record and recent momentum despite key absences including Aaron Judge on the 60-day injured list with a rib issue and additional pitching and offensive depth on the IL. The Mariners, meanwhile, have dropped five straight and 14 of their last 19, scoring sparingly and sitting eight games under .500 after a nine-game road trip against playoff contenders. Probable starters Bryce Miller (3.08 ERA) and Will Warren (4.18 ERA) set up a middling matchup, but Seattle’s offensive woes and Josh Naylor’s wrist soreness further tilt the implied probabilities toward the Yankees in this series finale.
